rules.scoring: Work in integer hundredths: h(x) = round(100*x) of a proj or floor as the file carries it (2 decimals). starters(roster): candidates are the roster's players with ir false, ordered by proj descending, then seen descending, then name ascending. For each position in lineup.slots, take the first n unused candidates of that position. Then for each entry of lineup.flex in order, take the first n unused candidates whose pos is in the entry's pos list. A slot is worth max(h(proj), bar), where bar is h(lineup.floor[pos]) for a fixed slot and the largest h(lineup.floor[p]) over the entry's pos list for a flex slot. A slot with no candidate left is worth bar. lineup(roster) is the sum of the slot values, and a floored starter still counts as a starter. gain = tenths(lineup(R2) - lineup(R1)) where R1 is the owner's values list, R2 is R1 minus send plus get (get players are taken from the partner's values list, matched by name, keeping their ir flag) minus drop, and tenths(d) is d/10 rounded half away from zero, divided by 10, so one decimal. The search keeps only offers with gain >= rules.min_gain before the drops. Dropping players who never start does not change the lineup, so drop never moves gain.
rules.drop: count = the players in R2-before-drops with ir false, plus other[owner]. over = count - lineup.cap. When over > 0, release the first `over` players of the owner's R2-before-drops who have ir false, are not in get and are not in starters(R2-before-drops), ordered by proj ascending, then seen ascending (as published, 1 decimal), then name ascending. K and D/ST (other) are never released. An offer that cannot reach the cap that way is not written. drop is [] when over <= 0. Only the owner's room is checked, never the partner's.
